title: Construction of affine derived tilde/global-sections adjunction
statement: For any commutative ring A with the derived categories D(A) and D(O_Spec A) in the indicated universes, there exist F : D(A) → D_QCoh(Spec A) and G : D_QCoh(Spec A) → D(A), an adjunction F ⊣ G, a natural isomorphism between Q followed by F and inclusion and termwise tilde followed by Q, and a natural isomorphism between G and derived global sections with scalars transported by ΓSpecIso.

proof.text: Use tilde.adjunction for the ordinary adjunction to scalar-transported evaluation. It supplies preservation of finite colimits. Prove preservation of monomorphisms directly: after faithful forgetting to presheaves, a section is a family of localized elements; equality of its images is pointwise equality under IsLocalizedModule.map. Apply IsLocalizedModule.map_injective to each prime and the injectivity of the original module monomorphism. Functor.preservesHomology_of_preservesMonos_and_cokernels then supplies preservation of homology, hence finite limits.

Take L.mapDerivedCategory. Its cohomology comparison mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso identifies every cohomology sheaf with tilde of module cohomology. Use Mathlib tilde quasi-coherence and closure under isomorphisms, then ObjectProperty.lift. Apply the source library mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction to the ordinary adjunction and restrictFullyFaithful along identity and the full QCoh inclusion. The left comparison is mapDerivedCategoryFactors; the right comparison is identity by construction.

lean.statement:
theorem affineQCohDerivedAdjunction_construction (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))] :
    ∃ (F : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory (Spec (.of A)))
      (G : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (Spec (.of A)) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)),
      Nonempty (F ⊣ G) ∧
      Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ F ⋙
        (schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A))).ι ≅
        @Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
          (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
            SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
            (tilde.functor (.of A))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Q) ∧
      Nonempty (G ≅ (schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A))).ι ⋙
        (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace ⋙
          ModuleCat.restrictScalars (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv.hom).rightDerivedFunctor)
